events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', an anthem for peace that still resonates globally. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Sting Turns 75
events.blurb: Legendary British musician Sting, born Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's Influence
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to Sting! From The Police to a stellar solo career, his distinctive voice and songwriting have shaped decades. What's your favourite Sting track?

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod to the world on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the first iPod dropped? That little white box changed everything. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Best Bond Theme
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007's enduring legacy. But the real question is: which Bond theme song truly holds the Licence to Thrill?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering music icon John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're reflecting on the profound impact of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy Gold
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique humour is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album,' was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' – a sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your hidden gem on this iconic record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the unparalleled talent of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Forever Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the world lost Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen song that showcases his genius?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' shifted the musical landscape. Its influence is undeniable. Which track from this album is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world tragically lost music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: It's 46 years since we lost John Lennon. His spirit of peace and his incredible music continue to inspire generations. What's the one Lennon song that moves you most?

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the visionary artist David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the extraordinary life and art of David Bowie. Which of his many personas or eras captured your imagination the most?

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Elvis Presley's impact on music and culture is truly unmatched. What's your all-time favourite Elvis hit?

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! His riffs defined a generation of rock. What's the most iconic Led Zeppelin guitar moment for you?

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! His distinctive voice has been soundtracking our lives for decades. What's your go-to Rod Stewart singalong?
